summary: Iteration 5 — Full E2E (backend + frontend) for the 3 new legacy-parity features (Compleanni, Stampa Tesserini PDF, Iscrizione pubblica). ALL CHECKS GREEN. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py covering POST /api/public/enrollment-requests (no-auth submit + 422 invalid email + _id leak guard), GET/POST /api/enrollment-requests (admin list, parent 403, approve creates student+parent+invite link, double-approve→400, reject flow, reject 404, DELETE cleanup), GET /api/birthdays (auth required, sorted by days_until, ranges 7/30/90/365, teacher allowed, parent 403), GET /api/barcodes/pdf (auth required, %PDF magic bytes + application/pdf content-type, classroom filter, parent 403). Frontend Playwright E2E end-to-end on https://nursery-smart.preview.emergentagent.com: public /iscrizione form fills + submits + success screen 'Richiesta inviata!' shows; Login page CTA login-enrollment-link present; admin login → /s/iscrizioni shows the new TESTF_Sofia request, Approve flow returns the mock invite link in data-testid=approve-invite-link with /setup-password/ path; /s/compleanni loads and all 4 range buttons (7/30/90/365) are clickable; /s/tesserini loads, 3 class pills (data-testid=bc-class-*) appear, 'Scarica PDF' triggers a real download (tesserini-tutti.pdf); StaffLayout nav has nav-compleanni, nav-tesserini, nav-iscrizioni (admin role).

minor.issue: Creates the new student with no enrollment in any classroom/school_year and no default classroom assignment — admin must manually enroll the approved student afterwards. Likely intended (admin chooses sezione later), but worth documenting in UI.

Builds invite_link from os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL','') — if FRONTEND_URL is unset the link starts with '/setup-password/...' (relative). In our env it resolved to the public URL, so it works, but consider falling back to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or request.url_for to make it robust.
Returns 404 'Nessun alunno trovato' when classroom is empty — fine, but the frontend toast says generic 'Errore'; consider surfacing the actual detail.
No rate-limit / captcha on the public endpoint — could be spammed. Acceptable for an Italian preschool but worth a note.

issues: Filter pill labels use the data-testid value (pending/approved/rejected/all) via `capitalize` Tailwind class on the underlying button, but the displayed text is correctly Italian (In attesa / Approvate / Rifiutate / Tutte). All good — just noting consistency.

action_items: (Optional) After approve, navigate the admin to /s/alunni or auto-open an enrollment modal so they can place the new child into a sezione without an extra hop.
(Optional) Make invite_link generation robust when FRONTEND_URL env is missing — fall back to request.base_url or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
(Optional) Add lightweight rate-limit (e.g., per-IP cooldown) on POST /api/public/enrollment-requests.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicEnrollment.jsx: form is well-structured, all 10 data-testids are wired, success state cleanly resets — good.

EnrollmentRequests.jsx uses window.confirm() for approve/reject — fine for admin tools but won't be intercepted by Playwright unless the test wires page.once('dialog', accept). Tests handled this; future agents take note.
BarcodePrint.jsx fetches the PDF via raw fetch() + manual Bearer header (bypassing axios). Works, but consider extracting an api.getBlob helper to share auth/error handling.
Birthdays endpoint loops all students in Python — fine at this scale (≤2000) but a MongoDB aggregation with $dateFromString could be faster for larger schools.
server.py still ~2298 lines (carry-over from iteration_4) — modularization remains overdue.
approve_enrollment uses purpose='invite' on the reset-token doc but the setup-password endpoint likely accepts the same token shape — verified end-to-end via the mock_invite_link path returned.
All new endpoints correctly exclude {_id:0} on Mongo reads — no ObjectId leakage observed.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TESTF_/TEST_ prefixed enrollment requests with unique timestamps in the email; pending request is approved (creates a TEST_-prefixed student which is cleaned up in teardown_class), a second one is rejected then DELETEd. One E2E-created request (TESTF_Sofia) is left approved in the DB — main agent may want to clean it up if not desired (admin can delete via UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py -v` (~6s). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is REQUIRED in the shell. The full iteration_4 backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is NOT re-run here (already 76/76 in iteration_4). Frontend Playwright covered the full happy path for all 3 features incl. mobile/desktop-agnostic flow at 1280x900. The approve flow in /s/iscrizioni uses window.confirm — tests must wire `page.once('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` BEFORE clicking approve/reject.
